intent: Attach a proving test to the reviewed rule run-terminal-status-is-final, whose reviewing package is no longer in the repository.
observable_outcome: coverage lists run-terminal-status-is-final as proven, and get-record names the obligation that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Run that has reached a terminal status never transitions again. succeeded, failed, cancelled and timed_out have no successors, and a command asking a Run to leave one of them is refused as an illegal transition.
